about: Contract between the Python training code (ml/) and the TypeScript app (app/src/ml/). Both read this file. Changing it means retraining and regenerating golden.csv.
roomSignal: max of the valid (not failed) heat-detector readings in the room, degC; NaN when every detector of the room has failed
failure: a detector fails the first time it reads above config.json fire.detectorFailureC (150 degC, as in NIST P-Flash) and returns NaN from then on
neighbours: rooms that share a door with the target room (any door state); NIST P-Flash runs: every other room of the run

features.name: self_t_last
features.what: room signal now; NaN if failed

features.name: self_slope_10
features.what: least-squares slope of the valid room signal over the last 10 s; NaN with fewer than 2 valid samples

features.name: self_t_max_60
features.what: max valid room signal over the last 60 s; NaN if none

features.name: self_frac_failed
features.what: failed detectors / detectors in the room, now

features.name: self_s_since_fail
features.what: time since the first detector of the room failed; NaN if none has

features.name: self_slope_at_fail
features.what: slope of the room signal over the 30 s before that first failure; NaN if none

features.name: nb_t_last_max
features.what: max of self_t_last over the neighbours; NaN if none valid

features.name: nb_slope_30_max
features.what: max of self_slope_30 over the neighbours; NaN if none valid

features.name: nb_frac_failed_max
features.what: max of self_frac_failed over the neighbours; 0 without neighbours

features.name: nb_s_since_fail_max
features.what: max of self_s_since_fail over the neighbours (earliest neighbour failure); NaN if none

features.name: nb_slope_at_fail_max
features.what: max of self_slope_at_fail over the neighbours; NaN if none

tff.target: seconds to flashover, capped at tffCapS (censored runs and late flashovers count as tffCapS)

golden: golden.csv: one row per sample, columns = feature names (empty cell = NaN) then p30, p60, tff as predicted by Python xgboost
